source_name: ORSR Zbierka listín (collection of deeds)
why_relevant: Lists the documents deposited for each entity — spoločenská zmluva/stanovy, rozhodnutia valného zhromaždenia (appointments/removals), podpisové vzory of new officers, projekty premien (merger/demerger plans), účtovné závierky. The list itself is a free change-signal timeline: a new 'rozhodnutie jediného spoločníka' or 'podpisový vzor' filing dates a leadership move precisely, even before the register entry is visible elsewhere.

source_name: Register účtovných závierok (RÚZ)
why_relevant: Mandatory repository of financial statements and annual reports (výročné správy) from 2013 onwards, run by DataCentrum under the Ministry of Finance. Annual reports of banks and payment institutions carry organisational structure, headcount (priemerný počet zamestnancov), board/supervisory-board composition and remuneration, subsidiary lists and post-balance-sheet events — i.e. the documentary backing for hiring and org-change analysis. Filing dates are themselves events.

source_name: Register partnerov verejného sektora (RPVS) — rýchle/rozšírené vyhľadávanie
why_relevant: Any bank, PSP or IT/payments vendor contracting with the Slovak state must be registered with its konečný užívateľ výhod (UBO) and oprávnená osoba, backed by verification documents (verifikačný dokument) that narrate the ownership and control chain — often in more detail than the commercial register. UBO and 'verifikácia' filings are dated events that reveal quiet ownership and control changes. Register maintained by MS SR, registering court Okresný súd Žilina.

source_name: Register právnických osôb, podnikateľov a orgánov verejnej moci (RPO) — ŠÚ SR
why_relevant: The Statistical Office's reference register consolidates data from source registers (commercial, trade, associations) and — crucially for this cell — carries the SK NACE classification that ORSR itself does not let you search by. This is the mechanism for enumerating the entire population of SK-registered financial and payment actors (SK NACE 64.19 iné peňažné sprostredkovanie, 64.99, 66.19, 66.12, 63.11) before drilling into each in ORSR.

source_name: RPO API dokumentácia (Apiary) — ŠÚ SR
why_relevant: Machine-readable contract for the RPO REST API: endpoints, filters (including changes since a date), response schema. Determines whether an automated org-change monitor can be built cheaply against the state register rather than by scraping.

source_name: Ekosystém Slovensko.Digital — otvorené dáta a API (Datahub)
why_relevant: Civic-tech aggregator that republishes the exact registers in this cell in usable form: RPO and RPO V2, Obchodný vestník, Register účtovných závierok, Centrálny register zmlúv, plus Sociálna poisťovňa / VšZP debtor lists. Offers REST APIs, an SQL API for analytical queries, and weekly full SQL dumps — the fastest path to a cross-register org-change feed without scraping eight state sites. Debtor lists (Sociálna poisťovňa) are also an indirect headcount/distress signal.

source_name: FinStat.sk — profil firmy: Obchodný register a Udalosti vo firme
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that normalises ~13 state sources (OR SR, Obchodný vestník, ŽR SR, RÚZ, tax office, RPVS) into a per-company event timeline ('Udalosti vo firme') covering statutory-body changes, share-capital moves, liquidations and RPVS changes, with email alerting and an API. Fastest way to detect a change; its value is timeliness and normalisation, but every event must be traced back to ORSR/Vestník for the authoritative date.

source_name: Ministerstvo spravodlivosti SR — Obchodný register: metodika, FAQ, formuláre
why_relevant: Authoritative guidance on what must be filed for each type of change and how fast the registry court must act (registration deadlines, mandatory electronic filing, required annexes for appointment/removal of a statutory body). Needed to interpret lag between a real-world decision, the filing and the visible register entry — i.e. to date events correctly rather than by publication date.

source_name: European e-Justice Portal — Business registers, Slovakia (BRIS entry point)
why_relevant: English-language gateway to the SK register through the EU Business Registers Interconnection System. Useful for cross-border cases — a Slovak branch (organizačná zložka) of an Austrian/Czech bank, or a SK subsidiary of an EU payments group — because BRIS links the SK entry to the parent's home register and, per the portal, allows free application for extracts and deposited documents.

source_name: org-id.guide — SK-ORSR identifier list
why_relevant: Canonical description of the SK-ORSR organisation-identifier scheme (IČO), its coverage and access conditions. Needed to make IČO the join key across ORSR, RPO, RÚZ, RPVS, Obchodný vestník and any commercial aggregator — the prerequisite for a coherent org-change dataset.

source_name: Bizdata.sk — dátové registre (SK company data provider)
why_relevant: Alternative commercial/technical provider documenting which Slovak state registers it ingests and how. Useful as a second normalised feed and as documentation of register update cadence and field structure; reduces dependence on a single aggregator.

source_name: AKMV advokátska kancelária — premeny obchodných spoločností / poplatky ORSR
why_relevant: Practitioner commentary that decodes register mechanics: what Act 309/2023 changed for mergers from 1.3.2024, what annexes accompany a statutory-body change, registry-court deadlines (two business days domestic, 21 days cross-border). Valuable as an interpretation layer so register timestamps are read correctly; not evidence of any specific company event.

source_name: Podnikam.sk / Podnikajte.sk — praktické výklady k ORSR, RÚZ a RPVS
why_relevant: Business-press explainers on register procedure, RÚZ filing obligations and RPVS duties, kept current year to year. Useful glossary and procedural reference for a non-native analyst, and a cheap way to notice when the rules or portals change.

source_name: Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA) — Členovia (member banks directory)
why_relevant: Enumerates the ~23-24 member banks covering ~99% of the Slovak banking sector — the canonical actor population for all follow-on A5 scouting (career pages, press rooms, management pages). Membership joins/exits are themselves organizational signals.

source_name: SBA — O nás / Prezídium (governing body with named officeholders + employers)
why_relevant: Names the 7-member Prezídium with each person's current title and bank (e.g. president Daniel Kollár/ČSOB; vice-presidents from Slovenská sporiteľňa, VÚB, Tatra banka; members from Prvá stavebná sporiteľňa, UniCredit), plus the executive director. Effectively a continuously refreshed CEO-level directory; term 30 May 2025 – 29 May 2029, so changes mid-term signal CEO turnover.

source_name: SBA — Novinky (association press room)
why_relevant: Publishes election of new presidium/president, executive-director appointments, memoranda with trade unions on banking-sector employee rights — i.e. leadership-move and sector-employment announcements at source, before media pickup.

source_name: SBA Educa — examinations body for financial intermediaries
why_relevant: SBA's training/exam arm; its governance and lecturer/examiner lists name banking professionals, and exam volumes are a proxy for hiring flows into financial intermediation.

source_name: Asociácia obchodníkov s cennými papiermi (AOCP) — Zoznam členov
why_relevant: Directory of licensed Slovak investment firms/securities dealers — the capital-markets actor population adjacent to banking. AOCP's elected výbor historically names individuals with employer (e.g. Salve Investments, Fio, UniCredit, Privatbanka, RM-S Market), giving a senior-management sample for the sector.

source_name: SAPIE — Slovak Alliance for Innovation Economy, general members directory
why_relevant: ~170-200 member companies spanning startups, fintechs, investors and corporates; the widest single directory of Slovak digital-economy actors, including payments/fintech players not captured by banking registers. SAPIE also produced a 'mapa slovenských inovátorov' (innovator map) — a pointer to yet more actor datasets.

source_name: IT Asociácia Slovenska (ITAS) — Členovia
why_relevant: 100+ ICT member companies with ~30k employees, incl. the systems integrators and vendors that staff bank IT/payments projects (Asseco CE, Posam, InterWay, Anasoft, Slovak Telekom, Microsoft, Cisco). A key employer population for A5 hiring signals on the supply side of banking technology.

source_name: ITAS — leadership election announcements (prezident/viceprezidenti/predstavenstvo)
why_relevant: Board-election posts name individuals together with their employer (Cisco, Microsoft, Asseco, Slovak Telekom, Posam, Samsung, Asbis…), i.e. a dated snapshot of ICT senior management. Repeated every term, so diffs are leadership-move signals.

source_name: AmCham Slovakia — Our Board
why_relevant: 17 board members elected by the General Assembly, each named with company (Citibank, Dell, KPMG, O2, U.S. Steel, MSD…). Includes financial-sector executives; board turnover is an explicit leadership-move signal and the page doubles as a verified title directory.

source_name: AmCham Slovakia — Our members (300+ companies)
why_relevant: 300+ member companies across sectors; the searchable directory identifies banks, payment providers and BSC/shared-service employers operating in SK — a high-yield seed list for hiring-signal scouting.

source_name: AmCham Slovakia — committees & working groups (15, incl. Digital, Employment and Social Affairs, Tax)
why_relevant: Committee rosters and chairs name mid/senior professionals with employers; the Employment and Social Affairs Committee and Digital Committee are directly on-topic for labour-market and digital-finance organisational signals.

source_name: Slovenská FinTech asociácia — Predstavenstvo (board)
why_relevant: Names the four-person board with bios, roles and employers (banking-tech veterans, a financial-services lawyer, a GoHealth VP) — the leadership directory of the Slovak fintech advocacy body founded 2018.

source_name: Slovenská FinTech asociácia — Členovia
why_relevant: Member directory of Slovak fintech/payment-adjacent firms — the actor population for the non-bank payments segment that regulator registers only partly cover.

source_name: AFISP — Asociácia finančných sprostredkovateľov a finančných poradcov
why_relevant: Since 2007 unites the major financial-intermediation and advisory firms; in 2025 it created expert committees (odborné komisie) that name sector professionals. Financial-advisory networks are large employers and their leadership churn is an A5 signal.

source_name: Slovenská asociácia poisťovní (SLASPO)
why_relevant: Member directory + governing bodies of Slovak insurers — the bancassurance-adjacent actor set; several members are bank-owned. Sector=both scope makes insurer leadership relevant.
